title: Finite quasi-coherent filtration of the reduction units kernel
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and $i:X_{\mathrm{red}}\to X$ its reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. Let $K=\ker(i^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}\to\mathbf G_{m,X_{\mathrm{red}}})$ in abelian etale sheaves [def-sc-gm-torsor, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. There exist $n\geq0$ and sheaves $E_j$ on $(X_{\mathrm{red}})_{\mathrm{Et}}$ with $E_0\simeq K$, $E_n=0$, and, for each $0\leq j<n$, a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $F_j$ and a short exact sequence $0\to E_{j+1}\to E_j\to i^{-1}(F_j)_{\mathrm{Et}}\to0$ [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. The additive coefficients are lifted to the universe of $\mathbf G_m$.

proof.text: Apply exists_nilradical_pow_succ_eq_bot to choose n with N^(n+1)=0. Define the filtration terms on X by the actual kernels E_j=reductionUnitsPowerKernel X j. The first term is the kernel of restriction to X_red, by N^1=N. The last term is zero: restriction to the closed subscheme of the zero ideal is an isomorphism, so its units map is an isomorphism and its kernel is zero. This last assertion is proved using the upperStar/lowerStar adjunction, its invertible unit for an isomorphism, and isIso_upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf.

Use exists_reduction_units_power_quotient for each j<n to obtain the required short exact complex on X and its additive quasi-coherent quotient. No arbitrary filtration is chosen from an unproved existence statement.

The reduction is a surjective closed immersion, hence a universal homeomorphism. Etale.isEquivalence_upperStar and Etale.isEquivalence_lowerStar identify its inverse and direct images as equivalences. Pull back the constructed E_j and use Functor.map_isZero and ShortExact.map_of_exact for the last term and short exact complexes. Map the three endpoint isomorphisms by Functor.mapIso. Identify U(E_0) with the kernel of U of the original units map by PreservesKernel.iso. The adjunction counit on G_m,X_red is invertible; kernelCompMono identifies the kernel after composing with it. Adjunction.homEquiv_counit says that this composite is upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf, and kernelIsoOfEq completes the identification. This proves the original statement with no signature change.

mathlib_searches.query: A noetherian scheme has a nilpotent nilradical and the kernel of units on its reduction has a finite filtration by quasi-coherent additive sheaves
Etale cohomology of a quasi coherent sheaf on a curve vanishes in degree two, nilpotent units filtration

lean.statement: theorem exists_reduction_units_finite_filtration (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] : ∃ (n : ℕ) (E : ℕ → Sheaf X.nilradical.subscheme.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}), Nonempty (E 0 ≅ kernel (upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf X.nilradical.subschemeι)) ∧ IsZero (E n) ∧ ∀ j, j < n → ∃ (F : X.Modules) (_ : F.IsQuasicoherent) (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf X.nilradical.subscheme.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})), S.ShortExact ∧ Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ E (j + 1)) ∧ Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ E j) ∧ Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.nilradical.subschemeι).obj ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F)))
